system.notes:
Gelatinous cubes can mutate to become magnetic, necrotic, or even regenerative! A green-tinted cube of clear jelly with bleached skeletons adrift inside.

AC 11, HP 24, ATK 1 touch +4 (1d8 + engulf), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5

Engulf. DC 12 STR or trapped inside cube. Touch attack auto-hits engulfed targets each round. DC 12 STR on turn to escape.

Necrotic. A creature who dies while engulfed becomes a skeleton.

Rubbery. Half damage from stabbing weapons.

Skeletons. Necrotic cubes have 1d6 skeletons inside them. Each round, one escapes to attack the cube’s enemies on a d6 roll of 1-3.

Art by Lucas Korte, 2023
